code_only_features.feature_name: finish tool ends the rollout loop
code_only_features.evidence: evals/environment.py TOOL_SPEC advertises `finish: {"summary": str} -> end the session.` and dispatch returns ToolResult(True, "Session ended.") for tool=='finish'. In evals/agent_loop.py run_rollout: `if tool_name == "finish": rollout.turns.append(...); break` -- the call is actually dispatched AND the loop breaks, so the subject can end the session early before exhausting condition.n_turns. This is end-to-end wired and honored.
